test_title: PYST 39: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 01 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The sentence has been divided into three parts, identify the error segment in the sentence given below. Choose no error if there is no error in the sentence.

Neither of them have shown any / interest in taking on the challenging / project that was assigned to the team.

options.text: interest in taking on the challenging
project that was assigned to the team.
Neither of them have shown any

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Neither"** is used to indicate that none of the two options is applicable or true. (दोनों में से कोई नहीं, कोई भी नहीं) • **Example: Neither of the two students** **was** able to solve the problem. • The correct form should be **"Neither of them has shown any"** instead of **"Neither of them have shown any"**. (दोनों में से कोई भी नहीं दिखाया है) • **Example: **Neither of them** has **completed the assignment yet. • Hence, the error is in the segment **"Neither of them have shown any"**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: no error** (कोई त्रुटि नहीं): This option would indicate that there is no mistake in the sentence. • **Example:** If the sentence was correct, this would be the right choice. • **Option 2: interest in taking on the challenging** (चुनौतीपूर्ण कार्य लेने में रुचि): This part of the sentence is grammatically correct. • **Example: **She has shown interest in taking on the challenging project. • **Option 3: project that was assigned to the team** (टीम को सौंपा गया प्रोजेक्ट): This part of the sentence is also correct and does not contain any grammatical errors. • **Example:** The project that was assigned to the team is due next month. 31:Tbbf, The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
